brief:
PROD-3812 — Webhook delivery retries with exponential backoff

Our webhook sender (lib/webhookSender.js) fires-and-forgets. When the receiver returns 5xx or times out we silently drop the event, and customers complain. Add resilient delivery:

- Wrap the existing `send(event, url)` in a `sendWithRetries(event, url, opts)`
- Retry on 5xx + network errors (NOT on 4xx — those are the receiver telling us 'don't bother')
- Exponential backoff with jitter: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s (jitter ±25%); cap at 4 attempts
- Each attempt has a 5-second timeout
- Return `{ ok: boolean, attempts: number, last_status: number|null, last_error: string|null }`
- Persist a delivery record for every attempt in `attempts[]` for observability

Keep the existing `send()` working; sendWithRetries is a wrapper.
acceptance_criteria: sendWithRetries(event, url) succeeds when the receiver eventually returns 2xx within 4 attempts
Returns ok=false after 4 failed attempts on persistent 5xx
Does NOT retry on 4xx (returns ok=false, attempts=1, last_status=4xx immediately)
Total wait between attempts respects 1s/2s/4s base with ±25% jitter
Each individual fetch attempt is bounded by a 5s timeout
Existing tests for the bare send() still pass

hidden_tests.name: retries succeed after transient 503

seeded_mistakes.bug_description: Compass may treat any non-2xx as retryable (status !== 200 → retry) which retries 4xx receiver errors and wastes 4 attempts.
seeded_mistakes.why_compass_might_suggest_it: The simplest 'retry on failure' code path doesn't distinguish 4xx from 5xx.
detection_signals: hidden test 'does NOT retry on 400' fails (attempts=4 instead of 1)

seeded_mistakes.bug_description: Compass may suggest pure exponential (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s) without jitter, which causes thundering-herd retries.
seeded_mistakes.why_compass_might_suggest_it: Jitter is the 'extra' detail; vanilla exponential is shorter and feels complete.
detection_signals: Hidden test for thundering-herd isn't shipped; surfaces in load testing — counts against code_quality score

rubric_anchors.check: Learner runs the hidden 4xx-no-retry case at least once
Backoff base + jitter factor + max attempts are named constants, not inline magic numbers

good_prompts_look_like: Ask Compass which HTTP status codes are retryable + why
Ask for the difference between exponential backoff and exponential backoff with jitter
common_verification_traps: Mocking the network without timing — never sees the backoff actually elapse

interview_parallel: Razorpay / Stripe backend lateral round — webhook resilience is a standard ask.
